entry_criteria: Sterling Grid V6: HMA pivot↓ + (UC rising OR MACD cross-up) + Price<$25 + Theme + Investment Gate PASS
exit_criteria: ExD compound exit (HMA pivot high + UC falling) OR tiered profit lock (+200%→15%, +100%→20%, +50%→25%)

themes.name: Grid Infrastructure Modernization
themes.thesis_summary: AI power demand is outpacing grid capacity by orders of magnitude, creating a structural bottleneck that must be solved regardless of AI cycle timing. Grid modernization represents the picks-and-shovels play for the AI boom.
key_catalysts: AI data centers consuming 1,000 TWh globally by 2026
Grid connection delays forcing behind-the-meter solutions

themes.name: Defense Industrial Base Modernization
themes.thesis_summary: Ukraine conflict revealed critical supply chain vulnerabilities requiring years of industrial base rebuilding. Defense spending shift from maintenance to capacity expansion creates multi-year investment cycle.
key_catalysts: Record defense backlogs creating multi-year visibility
New CMMC cybersecurity requirements creating barriers

themes.name: Industrial AI Infrastructure
themes.thesis_summary: AI infrastructure buildout requires massive industrial equipment - cooling systems, transformers, construction equipment. Less crowded way to play AI boom through essential enabling equipment.

themes.name: Healthcare Contrarian Recovery
themes.thesis_summary: Healthcare has massively underperformed since 2020 due to policy uncertainty and COVID impacts. With policy headwinds clearing and AI enabling efficiency gains, sector positioned for mean reversion.

themes.name: Energy Infrastructure Transition
themes.thesis_summary: Energy sector benefiting from geopolitical developments and infrastructure demand, but theme becoming crowded and execution risks around Venezuelan developments are high.
key_catalysts: Natural gas infrastructure for data centers

bullish_factors: ET-600 PDUFA decision Feb 25 with strong approval odds
Revenue growth accelerating: +129% YoY Q3, 19 consecutive quarters growth
Analyst consensus $30.50 target (+70% upside), 3 Buy/0 Hold ratings
risk_factors: Binary FDA decision in 3 days creates volatility
Small addressable markets (3,000 patients for ET-600)
Execution risk on multiple pipeline programs
pass_signals.reasoning: This is a classic binary biotech catalyst play with exceptional risk/reward. ETON has built a profitable rare disease franchise ($22.5M quarterly revenue, +129% growth) while approaching a major FDA decision that could unlock $100M+ in peak sales. The company's perfect FDA approval track record and strong ET-600 data package suggest high approval probability.
pass_signals.dd_key_catalyst: ET-600 PDUFA on Feb 25 (3 days): FDA decision on potential first-ever oral liquid desmopressin for pediatric AVP-D, addressing clear unmet need where caregivers currently cut tablets
pass_signals.dd_elevator_pitch: ETON is a rare disease specialty pharma experiencing explosive growth (+129% YoY revenue) with an imminent binary FDA catalyst in 3 days (Feb 25) that could unlock $100M+ in peak sales. The market underappreciates their perfect FDA track record and underestimates the multi-product launch momentum building through 2026.
pass_signals.dd_why_now: ET-600 PDUFA on Feb 25 (3 days): FDA decision on potential first-ever oral liquid desmopressin for pediatric AVP-D, addressing clear unmet need where caregivers currently cut tablets
pass_signals.dd_the_math: Q3 revenue $22.5M (129% growth) → Exit 2025 at ~$100M run rate → ET-600 approval adds $100M+ peak sales → Operating leverage drives 70%+ gross margins → Multiple re-rates from current ~23x fwd P/E to 35x rare disease peer average → $30 target (+65%)
pass_signals.dd_bear_case: High valuation at 8.8x P/S vs 6.1x peer average, company still unprofitable with debt/equity of 1.23, and success depends on flawless execution of multiple product launches simultaneously
pass_signals.dd_risk_to_monitor: ET-600 FDA decision on Feb 25 — a rejection would remove near-term catalyst and likely cause 20-30% selloff
pass_signals.dd_action: Buy Monday at open at ~$18. Full position. Set trailing stop at $14.40 (-20%). Monitor FDA decision Feb 25 closely for immediate reaction.

bullish_factors: Massive earnings beat ($0.19 vs $0.02 est) with raised 2026 guidance above analyst estimates
New product suite scaling rapidly - Flex users at 120K, Business customers 15K+ with 2x transaction sizes
AI-driven operational efficiency driving record low fraud rates (7.3 bps) and margin expansion
Strong institutional ownership at 86.56% with analyst consensus 'strong buy' and $20.50 avg target
risk_factors: Technical overbought condition following earnings pop creates near-term pullback risk
Fintech regulatory environment tightening with increased compliance costs
Cross-border payments facing competition from stablecoins and embedded finance solutions
pass_signals.reasoning: RELY demonstrates exceptional fundamental momentum with first-year GAAP profitability, 29% revenue growth, and 93% EBITDA growth while trading at reasonable forward multiples. New product pipeline scaling rapidly with management expecting revenue doubling in 2026. Technical overbought condition is temporary following major catalyst.
pass_signals.dd_key_catalyst: Q4 earnings beat Feb 18: EPS $0.19 vs $0.02 consensus with raised 2026 guidance + new CEO catalyst creating short squeeze conditions from 250x P/E compression to 12x forward
pass_signals.dd_elevator_pitch: RELY just posted first-year GAAP profitability with 29% revenue growth, appointed Amazon/Santander veteran as new CEO, and trades at just 11.76x forward P/E despite doubling new products revenue in 2026. The market's pricing this as a mature remittance company when it's actually becoming a cross-border financial platform.
pass_signals.dd_why_now: Q4 earnings beat Feb 18: EPS $0.19 vs $0.02 consensus with raised 2026 guidance + new CEO catalyst creating short squeeze conditions from 250x P/E compression to 12x forward
pass_signals.dd_the_math: FY2025 revenue $1.635B → 2026 guide $1.94-1.96B (19-20% growth) → 2028 target $2.6-3.0B. EBITDA margins expand from 17% to 20-22%. At peer multiple of 15x forward P/E (vs current 11.76x) = $27 target (+57%)
pass_signals.dd_bear_case: 250x trailing P/E suggests overvaluation, new products are unproven revenue drivers, and high institutional ownership (86.56%) creates crowding risk if momentum reverses
pass_signals.dd_risk_to_monitor: New product adoption rates — specifically whether Remitly Credit and expanded Wallet features achieve targeted revenue contribution doubling in 2026
pass_signals.dd_action: Buy Monday at open at ~$17.15. Full position. Set trailing stop at $13.72 (-20%). Monitor Q1 earnings May 6 for new product traction metrics
